canonical_record_policy.source_of_truth: versioned CARR records; projections, providers, routes, exports, and models are never canonical facts
canonical_record_policy.time_policy: observation time records when CARR saw a claim; effective interval records when the claim is asserted to apply; open effective_to means currently asserted, never permanently true
canonical_record_policy.conflict_policy: Conflicting assertions are immutable participants in a first-class conflict. A resolution receipt names the selected assertion, rationale, resolver, time and supporting evidence; losing assertions remain preserved.
canonical_record_policy.tenant_integrity: Every tenant-owned relation carries organization_tenant_id. Cross-table references are tenant-qualified; a UUID alone is never authorization or a valid relationship.

Property.rule: Property is identity-only. Names, addresses and every other display fact are FieldAssertions with provenance.

RightsReceipt.rule: Immutable versioned receipt with one locked contiguous successor chain per policy. Effective/current rights derive from that chain plus immutable revocation receipts, never mutable old active flags; intake and assertions fail closed unless the exact field/use is current.

SourceEvidence.rule: append-only; the exact provider and policy lineage of the governing rights receipt is preserved

FieldAssertion.rule: append-only; top-level value is non-null valid JSON/JSONB while nested JSON null remains representable; every factual value carries provenance, observation and effective time, rights, confidence, classification and review state; resolves display facts only through reviewed, still-effective assertions

FactConflict.rule: participants and one exclusive resolution receipt are separately immutable; the receipt selects one matching participant, so no mutable participant promotion is required

TourPropertyMembership.rule: Append-only selected property, order, label and route version. Membership and first projection serialize through the tenant-qualified tour row; a route version accepts no late members after its first projection exists.

PublicTourProjection.rule: Append-only point-in-time projection. Projection creation locks the tenant-qualified tour row and rechecks the membership set/as_of. Fact and seal operations lock tour then projection, so an immutable seal receipt closes draft assembly without a race.

ProjectionFact.rule: Append-only. Only an allowlisted, reviewed public assertion belonging to a selected property at the projection route version, selected by projection as_of, effective at projection as_of and covered by current client-public rights, may enter while the projection is unsealed draft; display_field_key equals assertion.field_key in v1.

CheatSheetRevision.rule: append-only editable internal material; it cannot mutate canonical facts or public projections

ShareGrant.rule: Append-only. Only an unguessable token digest is stored; scopes are limited to view_packet/view_map and rotation is one locked contiguous chain within one tenant/projection. Effective access derives from that chain and immutable revocation receipts, never a grant rewrite.

QualityFinding.rule: QC can block or quarantine but cannot alter facts, approve publication, or dismiss its own finding

AuditEvent.rule: append-only; an audit record is never a mutable business object

public_projection_policy.structural_rule: No arbitrary JSON payload is persisted as a public fact. Renderer input is derived from ProjectionFacts; each ProjectionFact has tenant-qualified reviewed provenance, effective-as-of/current-rights validation, and a field-specific scalar/object allowlist that rejects unknown nested keys.
public_projection_policy.parity_rule: web packet, map cards, ordered itinerary, and PDF render from the same approved PublicTourProjection version; a PDF must have exactly one property page per selected property or fail QC

internal_detail_subject.rule: Return the stored opaque subject unchanged, including null for unbound legacy tours. Consumers may bind client notes only when subject_type is client and subject_id is a valid client identity. This internal read does not authorize a note write or expose subject fields in public projections.
